notes_for_other_areas: CommandTurn.namedProjectId (packages/runtime/src/loop/ports.ts) and IntentContext.namedProjectId (packages/commands/src/intent.ts): the project an earlier turn of this conversation switched to; pronouns ('there', 'it', 'dort', 'es') resolve to it or ask 'Which project: …?'. matchProjects (commands/shared.ts) never matches a pronoun and matches at word starts.

RecallScope.seen (conversation/recall.ts) keeps every hit of a turn with its strength; namedSources(reply, scope, tz, now) now takes the scope (opened, then seen hits).
